meta.name: landing-page-design
meta.description: Landing page conversion optimization with layout rules, hero section design, and CTA psychology. Covers above-the-fold formula, social proof placement, mobile design, and F-pattern reading. Use for: startup landing pages, product pages, SaaS marketing, conversion optimization. Triggers: landing page, hero section, above the fold, conversion optimization, landing page design, cta button, hero image, landing page layout, saas landing page, product page design, conversion rate, landing page best practices

copy.tagline: 优化落地页布局与文案，提升转化率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在优化产品页或营销落地页的转化效果
copy.tagline_en: Optimize landing page layout and copy to boost conversion rates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are optimizing product or marketing landing pages for higher conversions

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据落地页设计规则（如首屏公式、CTA 心理学、社交证明布局）提供优化建议，并可通过 CLI 生成英雄图、研究竞品等。
howto.when: 当你询问落地页设计、首屏、转化优化、CTA 按钮、英雄图、布局、SaaS 落地页、产品页设计、转化率或落地页最佳实践时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个SaaS落地页的首屏，包含标题、副标题和CTA。
say.note: Claude 会按首屏公式给出布局和文案建议。

say.text: 生成一张展示产品成果的英雄图。
say.note: Claude 会调用 CLI 生成图片。

say.text: 分析这个落地页的CTA按钮设计。
say.note: Claude 会依据规则评估颜色、大小、文案等。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can provide optimization suggestions based on landing page design rules (e.g., above-the-fold formula, CTA psychology, social proof placement) and generate hero images or research competitors via CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about landing page design, hero section, above the fold, conversion optimization, CTA button, hero image, landing page layout, SaaS landing page, product page design, conversion rate, or landing page best practices.

say_en.text: Design a SaaS landing page hero with headline, subheadline, and CTA.
say_en.note: Claude will provide layout and copy suggestions per the formula.

say_en.text: Generate a hero image showing the product outcome.
say_en.note: Claude will call CLI to generate the image.

say_en.text: Analyze the CTA button design on this landing page.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate color, size, copy, etc.
